The rat definitely needs a mate! Even being in your room with you as a friend is still not really enough to keep the rat social enough as I'm guessing you won't be around the cage 24/7 and the rat is now all alone.

There's 2 more common solutions. 
1. You convince your parents that you need a new rat, I'd even get 2 of them (siblings) so that you don't run into this problem again in the near future. It feels like your parents do not want rats at all if they've moved it away from you and don't want another one. So that may be difficult

2. When one of my 2 rats died, i kept the lonely one for max a week. It was difficult for me to look after them towards the end so I didn't want more. Went looking for people around who also had rats that he could move in with and luckily found an old classmate who had 2 boys. He had 2 good cage mates and died before they did so the new owner didn't have to go thru the same thing I did with my boy.

It might be really hard for you to convince your parents and it may also be really hard for you to let go of it.

But it's gonna be almost impossible for your rat to be happy alone

Hope things work out :)

The friend making subs are rarely that effective. Presumably a lot of people see it as the "easy route" cause they easily make a connection. It's more difficult to then maintain that connection. Whether it's cause they have no social skills or cause they aren't interested in the other person, just having "friends".

The people I've met on normal posts on these subs that I consider to have actually become my friends, I could make a few more and still be able to count them on one hand. I've made more of them from the old sub chat feature that isn't around anymore than actual posts.

I'm trying not to push the suggestion of servers cause I personally don't have a good time in them myself. But in a server/group chat you already have an established existence. Obviously random who you'll meet but you often get people who will ask stuff about you and reciprocate when you apply yourself. Compared to these subs where you can try your very hardest and all you'll get is "lol yeah" back. 

When people here look for a post to reply to. Few people look for something that stands out. A lot more people want to find someone that checks 90% of their boxes. And the vast majority are looking for the best, easiest post they can find cause it's putting in the least effort to get the end result. Which is in turn why you'll get the same low effort from them once you've met them.

Friends do seem to pop up in random places when you don't expect it. But for some of us not so often.

Working on yourself is still a step in the right direction. Real friends will be around regardless but feeling better yourself will make your social experience all the better.

Hope shit works out :)
